Three persons ‘Ashish’, ‘Bijal’ and ‘Charan’ started a business by making investments in the ratio (2/3) : (3/5) : (5/7), respectively. 4 months before the end of the year, ‘Bijay’ withdrew (2/3)rd of his initial investment. If the total annual profit received by them together is Rs. 6,984, then find the difference between profits received by ‘Ashish’ and ‘Charan’.

properties.html: Mukesh started a business with Rs.45,000. Bharat joined him 3 months later with Rs. 32,000. After 3 months Mukesh withdrew Rs.5,000 of his capital and 2 more months later, Bharat brought in Rs.13,000 more. At the end of the year, what will be the ratio in which they share the profits if Mukesh receives 20% of profits as commission?

properties.html: Each of the two friends - A and B - lend Rs. 20,000 to G, who is starting a business. G agrees to pay only 15% of the annual profit to A, while 12% of the annual profit in addition to 5% interest per year on his loan to B. What amount of the profit (in Rs.) is left with G, if it is known that A receives Rs. 119 more than B at the end of the year?

properties.html: Pranav, Harman and Chirag ventured into a new business. Pranav contributed Rs.10,000 for 6 months, Harman invested 16,000 for 5 months and Chirag invested certain sum for 8 months. Chirag manages the entire business s for which he takes 25% of the profit and the remaining profit is shared among Pranav, Harman and Chirag in the respective ratio of there cumulative investments. If at the end of the 8 months the profit realized was Rs. 20,000. Find the sum that Chirag invested, if profit received by Harman is Rs. 4000

properties.html: A man sold his old car and divided the money received among his three sons A, B, and C in a ratio of 5 : 4 : 6. A and B started a business from their shares and C joined them after 4 months and simultaneously A and B withdrew Rs. 10000 and Rs. 8000, respectively, from the business. They hired a manager at Rs. 2000 per month for their business to whom only B and C paid from their share of profit equally at the end of 1 year. If C gets Rs. 48000 profit share (after paying to the manager) out of a total profit of Rs. 177000, find the money received by the man from the sold car.
